description: Blue Origin’s New Glenn rocket exploded during a hotfire test at Cape Canaveral on May 28, 2026. The loss could impact NASA’s Artemis Moon plans and future Amazon Kuiper satellite launches.
title: Blue Origin’s New Glenn Rocket Explodes During Pre-Launch Test in Florida

description: Activision has announced that it is ending support for Call of Duty: Warzone on last-gen consoles. The free-to-play Battle Royale title will no longer be playable on PS4 and Xbox One, starting with the launch of Season 1 content for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, which launches on PC and current-gen consoles on October 23, 2026.
title: Activision to Shut Down Call of Duty: Warzone on PS4, Xbox One After Modern Warfare 4 Launch

description: Vivo Over-Ear Noise-Cancelling Headphones have been launched in China. They feature a 40mm dynamic driver unit with a frequency response range of 20Hz to 40kHz. The headphones are compatible with AAC, SBC, and LDAC audio codecs and support DeepX 3.0 stereo sound technology. The headphones can be connected with up to three devices simultaneously and are claimed to deliver up to 75 days of battery life on a single charge.
title: Vivo Over-Ear Noise-Cancelling Headphones Launched With Up to 75 Hours of Battery Life

description: Vivo TWS 5e was launched in China on Friday alongside the Vivo S60. The true wireless stereo (TWS) earphones come with up to 55dB hybrid adaptive active noise cancellation (ANC), compared to the 30dB ANC offered on its predecessor, the Vivo TWS 3e. As per the company, its latest offering has a stem-style design with silicone ear tips and rounded outer shells. The Vivo TWS 5e can deliver up to 55 hours of total battery life, including the charging case.
title: Vivo TWS 5e Launched in China With 1mm Dynamic Drivers, Hybrid Adaptive ANC, Up to 55 Hours Battery Life

description: Motorola Edge 70 Pro+ will be launched in India with the same chipset as the Edge 70 Pro, the company revealed on Friday. The handset will be powered by an octa core MediaTek Dimensity 8500 Extreme chipset, which is claimed to have scored more than 24,00,000 points on the AnTuTu benchmarking platform. The upcoming Motorola Edge 70 Pro+ will also be equipped with a 6,500mAh battery, which is claimed to provide more than two days of battery life. On top of this, the handset is now confirmed to sport a 6.8-inch 1.5K Extreme AMOLED display, offering up to 5,200 nits peak brightness.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Pro+ Key Specifications Revealed Days Ahead of Launch in India on June 4

description: France’s financial regulator has given crypto firms until June 30 to secure a MiCA licence or begin winding down operations. The warning comes amid broader debates within the EU over passporting rules and regulatory oversight.
title: France's Financial Markets Authority Sets June 20 Deadline for Crypto Firms to Acquire  MiCA Licence

description: The OTT platforms are ready to drop a fresh set of releases, including Jolly LLB 3, Spider Noir, Cousins and Kalyanams, and more.
title: New OTT Releases This Week (May 25 - May 31): Jolly LLB 3, Kara, Spider-Noir, Leader, Roomates, and More

description: Vivo S60 has been launched in China, the smartphone maker announced on Friday. The handset was unveiled during the tech firm’s May 2026 event, which also witnessed the launch of the Vivo TWS 5e. The handset is powered by an octa core Snapdragon 8s Gen 3 chipset from Qualcomm. The phone will go on sale in China via the company’s online store in Early Summer Green, Midsummer Night's Dream, and Sea of ​​Stars (translated from Chinese) colourways. It packs a 7,200mAh battery with support for 90W wired fast charging.
title: Vivo S60 Launched With 7,200mAh Battery and 144Hz Display, Vivo S60 Vitality Edition Tags Along: Price, Specifications

description: Honor Win Turbo launched in China with a 10,000mAh battery. It has a 6.79-inch display and runs on the MediaTek Dimensity 8500 Racing Edition chipset coupled with up to 16GB of RAM and up to 512GB of onboard storage. The Honor Win Turbo features a dual rear camera unit, led by a 50-megapixel primary sensor. It is offered in three colour options.
title: Honor Win Turbo Launched With 10,000mAh Battery, Dimensity 8500 Racing Edition Chipset: Price, Specifications

description: May 2026 was an eventful month for smartphone launches in India. Several brands announced handsets across the flagship and mid-range segments. ivo and Oppo refreshed their premium lineups with camera-focused offerings such as the Vivo X300 Ultra, Vivo X300 FE, Oppo Find X9 Ultra, and Oppo Find X9s. Meanwhile, Motorola finally brought its book-style Razr Fold to India. OnePlus also expanded its Nord portfolio with the launch of the Nord CE 6 and Nord CE 6 Lite.
title: Smartphones Launched in India (May 2026): Motorola Razr Fold, Oppo Find X9 Ultra, Vivo X300 Ultra and More

description: 007 First Light has reached 1.5 million copies sold in just 24 hours of launch, developer IO Interactive has announced. The James Bond action-adventure game released on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series S/X on May 27. The game has also received widespread critical acclaim, and is one of the highest-rated games of 2026 so far.
title: 007 First Light, IO Interactive's James Bond Title, Sells 1.5 Million Copies in Just 24 Hours of Launch

description: Sathi Leelavathi is a light-hearted romantic family drama filled with humour, emotions and modern relationship conflicts.
title: Sathi Leelavathi OTT Release: Where to Watch Lavanya Tripathi’s Romantic Drama?

description: Boat Storm Call 4 and Ultima Vogue 2 smartwatches launched in India with support for direct USB Type-C charging. They offer Bluetooth calling functionality and feature a 1.96-inch touchscreen display. They have a blood oxygen saturation (SpO2) sensor. The new wearables offer more than 100 sports modes and have an IP68 rating for dust and water resistance.
title: Boat Storm Call 4, Ultima Vogue 2 Launched in India With USB Type-C Charging, Bluetooth Calling

description: Vivo T5 has been launched in select global markets as the latest addition to the company’s lineup. The new handset is currently available for purchase via the Vivo Mexico online store. The smartphone is offered in two colour options, dubbed Black and Golden (translated from Spanish). It is on sale in the country in a single 8GB + 256GB RAM and storage configuration. The Vivo T5 is powered by an octa core Snapdragon 6s Gen 2 chipset from Qualcomm, paired with a 7,200mAh battery. The phone supports 44W wired fast charging via a USB Type-C port.
title: Vivo T5 Launched With 7,200mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Acer Predator Atlas 8 has been launched in select global markets. The new gaming handheld from the tech firm will go on sale in North America, EMEA, and Australia in October 2026 via the Acer online store. It will be offered in a single Black colour option. The gaming handheld will ship with two processor options, configurable up to an Intel Arc G3 Extreme processor. Moreover, it will feature up to 24GB of RAM and a dedicated Intel GPU. The Acer Predator Atlas 8 is also equipped with a dual-fan cooling system for thermal management.
title: Acer Predator Atlas 8 Launched With Up to Intel Arc G3 Extreme Processor, 8-Inch 120Hz Display

description: Activision and Infinity Ward have fully revealed the next Call of Duty. Promised to be a major technical leap, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 will launch on PC, PS5, Xbox Series S/X, and Switch 2 on October 23, 2026. The shooter is now available to pre-order.
title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Revealed; Will Launch on PC, Consoles, and Switch 2 on October 23

description: The Xiaomi FX Mini LED Series will be launched in India next week, the company announced on Friday. The upcoming TV lineup will bring Mini LED display technology, which was previously seen with the Xiaomi TV S Mini LED (2026), alongside Amazon Fire TV integration and the company's proprietary Quantum MagiQ Technology. As per the company, the upcoming lineup is designed to deliver enhanced contrast, smoother motion handling, and improved picture quality for movies, sports, and gaming.
title: Xiaomi FX Mini LED Series India Launch Date Announced; Company Confirms Fire TV Integration, Quad Speaker Setup

description: Bitcoin traded near $73,500 on Friday as whale outflows, macroeconomic uncertainty, and weak risk appetite kept the crypto market range-bound. Analysts said traders remain focused on ETF flows, inflation trends, and key support levels for clues on the market’s next move.
title: Bitcoin Holds Near $73,500 as Weak Momentum Keeps Crypto Markets Range-Bound

description: Qualcomm has introduced the new Snapdragon C processor, which will power the future entry-level laptops, the chipmaker announced on Thursday. The San Diego-based tech giant has also announced that upcoming entry-level laptops, priced at $300 (roughly Rs. 29,000) and more, from OEMs like Acer, HP, and Lenovo will be powered by the company’s latest Snapdragon C chipset. On top of this, Qualcomm says that its Snapdragon C platform is equipped with an integrated NPU to bring AI capabilities to budget laptops.
title: Snapdragon C Processors Unveiled for Entry-Level Laptops With Support for AI Tasks, Improved Battery Efficiency

description: On the Roam Season 2 follows Jason Momoa as he travels across the world discovering artisans, creativity and cultural traditions.
title: On the Roam Season 2 OTT Release: When and Where to Watch Jason Momoa’s Docuseries?

description: Bheemseri is an emotional rural drama film that is now available to stream for rent, only on Amazon Prime Video. Watch now.
title: Bheemseri Out on OTT: Know Where to Stream This Telugu Rural Drama Film Online

description: Faces follows Nithya, a woman haunted by trauma and visions of her missing boyfriend after a mysterious gas explosion.
title: Faces OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch the Psychological Thriller Online?

description: Oura Ring 5 was launched globally on Wednesday as the latest model in the company's smart ring lineup. As per the company, the wearable has a significantly smaller design compared to the Oura Ring 4 and comes with upgraded sensors, new health-tracking capabilities, and AI-powered wellness features. Alongside the Ring 5, Oura has also introduced several software features, including Health Radar, Blood Pressure Signals, Live Activity Tracking, GLP-1 Insights, and AI-powered health assistance.
title: Oura Ring 5 Launched With Smaller Design, AI Health Features, Blood Pressure Tracking: Price, Specifications

description: Acer Swift Spin 14 AI and the Aspire Go 15 laptops have been launched. The Acer Swift Spin 14 AI can be configured with the Snapdragon X2 Elite or Snapdragon X2 Plus processor. It has a 14-inch touch display and a 65Wh battery. The Acer Aspire Go 15 runs on the Snapdragon C platform. It features a 15.6-inch display and a 53Wh battery.
title: Acer Swift Spin 14 AI Launched With Touch Display and Up to Snapdragon X2 Elite Alongside Aspire Go 15

description: Meta has launched Facebook Plus, Instagram Plus, and WhatsApp Plus. It is currently available to select users and is confirmed to bring new features. The new features and all subscriptions are being tested under Meta One. The Instagram Plus and Facebook Plus reportedly cost $3.99 (roughly Rs. 350) per month. WhatsApp Plus is said to be priced at $2.99 (roughly Rs. 270) per month. Subscribers will get access to premium features, including profile customisation and Super Reactions.
title: Meta Announces Facebook Plus, Instagram Plus and WhatsApp Plus Subscription Plans: See Price, Features

description: With WWDC 2026 on the horizon, leaks about Apple’s upcoming software for iPhone, iPad, and Mac are surfacing at a rapid pace. A report has now provided a detailed first look at the Cupertino-based tech giant’s revamped Siri assistant in iOS 27. The illustrations reveal a redesigned Siri experience that resembles modern AI chatbots such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude. The update is expected to introduce a dedicated Siri app, conversational chat history, personalised AI assistance, and a new "Search or Ask" interface integrated with the Dynamic Island.
title: iOS 27 Leak Reveals New Standalone Siri App, AI Search and Advanced Photos Tools for iPhone: Report

description: Motorola Edge 70 Pro+ has been spotted on the Geekbench benchmarking platform. The smartphone appears with an octa core MediaTek MT6899 chipset, which is said to be the MediaTek Dimensity 8500 SoC. Hence, the upcoming smartphone could be equipped with a slightly different SoC than the Motorola Edge 70 Pro, which is powered by an octa core MediaTek Dimensity 8500 Extreme. However, the company has yet to confirm these details. On top of this, the listing reveals that the Motorola Edge 70 Pro+ will ship with at least 12GB of RAM and Android 16. The phone is set to launch in India on June 4.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Pro+ Visits Geekbench With Familiar MediaTek Chipset: Expected Specifications, Features

description: The Xiaomi 17T series was launched in the global markets on Thursday. The lineup, which succeeds the Xiaomi 15T series, comprises two models — Xiaomi 17T and Xiaomi 17T Pro. Both handsets are equipped with Leica-tuned triple rear camera systems. The MediaTek Dimensity 8500-Ultra SoC powers the former, while the latter gets the Dimensity 9500 chip. The Xiaomi 17T models sport 1.5K AMOLED screens and run on Android 16-based HyperOS 3.
title: Xiaomi 17T, Xiaomi 17T Pro Launched With 1.5K AMOLED Screens, Leica Cameras: Price, Specifications
